journal_lines: §aSmelled it before I saw it. §oDark dust, mineral sharp, a whole buried forest.§o §lCoal§l seam, wide and consistent.
§aDusty work. Black on the muzzle, black in the bag. Coal.
§aCharcoal smell deep in the stone. §oLike something that burned long ago and never finished.§o Wide vein. Took it.
§aWorked the wall for an hour. §lCoal§l the whole way down.
§aBlack running the length of the passage, thick as a finger. Easy pickings.
§aThe seam crumbled soft under the pick. §oCoal dust hung in the air for a while after.§o Good take.
§aStruck stone, then found the black layer behind it. Seam ran wider than the tunnel.
§aQuick work. §lCoal§l close to the surface, almost asking to be taken.
§aPowdery at the face, harder further in. Took both kinds. Coal is coal.
§aFound the vein by the smell. §oDamp, old-burn, something mineral underneath.§o Followed it until it split. Took both branches.
§aA stripe of black in the grey stone, straight as intention. Worked it clean.
§aMore coal than the bag wanted. Left some. It will keep.
